_comment: Shape of the gitignored deployments.json, which records what's deployed where.
Written automatically by the deploy-tokens and deploy-all hardhat tasks - you don't normally
edit it by hand. The exception is mainnet token addresses: this repo never deploys USDC/USDT
to mainnet, so fill those in yourself from the issuers' own documentation. Do not copy them
from memory or from a snippet like this one.
Addresses recorded here are verified against the chain before reuse: an entry whose address
has no bytecode means the chain was reset, and the deploy tasks will replace it.

tokens.USDC: FILL IN: canonical Circle USDC on Base, from Circle's own docs
tokens.USDT: FILL IN: canonical USDT on Base, from Tether's own docs
